product_metadata.title: Idea Nouva Better Homes & Gardens Flowing Floral Comforter Set, Twin/TwinXL, Blue
features: Twin/ Twin XL: Comforter (66" x 86"), shams (20" x 26")
description: Complete the setting of a fun dorm room or teen room with the Flowing Floral Comforter Set. Crafted from beautiful poly cotton material with polyester fill, this set is durable and functional. Featuring an all over floral print, this comforter set creates a unique and elegant atmosphere. The set reverses to another beautiful floral print with alternating colors from the front side. The reversible feature allows for you to change the look of your room whenever you want. This comforter set is machine washable (please make sure to see care instructions label) for easy care. This set is designed for your sleeping comfort, so that you are able to relax and unwind. This comforter set comes with a comforter, sham(s) and 18 x 18 decorative pillow to create a coordinating bedroom look. The decorative pillow features fun print with pom poms.
